note: Prototype decisions for Step Four. The book's d20 rolls are not offered; the player chooses. As in the book, focuses can be the option's examples, any focus from the Focus Probability Matrix (p.85-88), or the player's own.

disciplineSwap.note: Interpretation of the civilian 'reduce one of your other disciplines by 1': the reduced discipline must be one not increased at this step and must currently be at least 2, so it never drops below the starting score of 1.
